portal_hypertension.title: Multicenter study of bleeding and thromboembolic events with durvalumab tremelimumab vs. atezolizumab and bevacizumab in advanced HCC.
portal_hypertension.authors: Ben Khaled N, Mohr R, Jochheim LS
portal_hypertension.zhSummary: 该文聚焦门静脉高压症，属于临床研究。核心观点：这种差异可能具有安全性影响，因为抗 VEGF 成分可能会增加出血和血栓栓塞事件的风险。 临床提示：Atezolizumab/贝伐单抗 (A/B) 和 durvalumab ± tremelimumab (DT/D) 是治疗肝细胞癌 (HCC) 的首选一线方案。
portal_hypertension.abstract: Atezolizumab/bevacizumab (A/B) and durvalumab ± tremelimumab (DT/D) are preferred first-line regimens for the treatment of hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC). Although both therapies share an anti-PD-L1-backbone, only the A/B-combination is targeting vascular-endothelial-growth-factor (VEGF). This difference may have safety-implications, as the anti-VEGF component may elevate the risk of bleeding and thromboembolic events. This multicenter study analyzes bleeding or thromboembolic events in patients receiving therapy with DT/D, compared with A/B. Patients with HCC treated with A/B exclusively before the approval of DT/D, or treated with DT/D, were recruited from 11 tertiary centers and analyzed ...
